sql:
WITH filtered_tickets AS (
  SELECT tk.id, t.name AS merchant_name,
    extract(year from tk.created_at) AS yr,
    extract(quarter from tk.created_at) AS qtr,
    tk.created_at, tk.resolved_at,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sla_breaches sb WHERE sb.ticket_id = tk.id) AS has_breach
  FROM tickets tk
  JOIN tenants t ON tk.tenant_id = t.id
  WHERE t.name IN ('Cragsley Outfitters','Marrowby & Vane','Studio Vrij','Grind Collective')
    AND tk.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND tk.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT merchant_name,
  yr::text || '-Q' || qtr::text AS quarter,
  count(*) AS tickets_created,
  round(avg(extract(epoch from (resolved_at - created_at))/3600) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 1) AS avg_resolution_hours,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from (resolved_at - created_at))/3600) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL)::numeric, 1) AS median_resolution_hours,
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_breach) / count(*), 1) AS sla_breach_rate_pct
FROM filtered_tickets
GROUP BY merchant_name, yr, qtr
ORDER BY merchant_name, yr, qtr
